name: harmonia
description: Premium local-first music workspace for people who still own their music libraries
author: Codex

scripts.clean:electron-xattrs: xattr -cr node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app 2>/dev/null || true; find node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app -exec xattr -d com.apple.FinderInfo {} \; -exec xattr -d 'com.apple.fileprovider.fpfs#P' {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.pack:mac: npm run clean:electron-xattrs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean:electron-xattrs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg
